Results.ReviewText: I made a big mistake buying this mouse today.  It is a must-have for me that the mouse be compatible with my Logitech Unifying receiver.  So before going to Officeworks, I checked the Logitech documentation (https://www.logitech.com/assets/64693/2/kaluga-b330-m280m330m320m331.pdf).  It clearly states: "the mouse itself is Unifying-ready and can be used with any Logitech® Unifying receivers you may already have."  Hooray!  Except, the M280 is *not* compatible with Unifying receivers.  The Logitech AI chatbot now gives me this rubbish: "the sentence you quoted in that combined manual is best understood as an error / over‑generic text that doesn’t match how the M280 actually works in practice."
Results.Title: Logitech's documentation is catastrophically wrong
